prompts: The game went down in June and we owe the team an incident report. The logs and their notes are in {WS}/logs. When did it start and end, how long was it, did we keep our monthly availability target, and why did it happen? Record it in {WS}/result.json: start, end, minutes_down, availability_june_pct, slo_999_ok, root_cause.
answers:
[goal]
Produce the June outage incident report and write [result.json](<WORKSPACE>/result.json) with `start`, `end`, `minutes_down`, `availability_june_pct`, `slo_999_ok`, and `root_cause`.

[action]
Read [README.md](<WORKSPACE>/logs/README.md) and scanned [gameserver-2026-06-01.log](<WORKSPACE>/logs/gameserver-2026-06-01.log), [gameserver-2026-06-02.log](<WORKSPACE>/logs/gameserver-2026-06-02.log), and [gameserver-2026-06-03.log](<WORKSPACE>/logs/gameserver-2026-06-03.log) for warnings, errors, fatals, and recovery markers, then recorded the metrics in [result.json](<WORKSPACE>/result.json).

Assumptions for choices left open by the brief:
- Timestamp format in `start` and `end` matches the raw log timestamp string (`YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`).
- `minutes_down` is computed from the exact second delta (`2149s / 60 = 35.8167`, rounded to 2 decimal places: `35.82`).
- `availability_june_pct` is computed against all 30 days of June (`2,592,000` seconds = `43,200` minutes): `(2592000 - 2149) / 2592000 * 100 = 99.917091...%`, rounded to 4 decimal places (`99.9171`).

[result]
What I found and how I know it is right:
- **Definition of downtime** ([README.md](<WORKSPACE>/logs/README.md#L1)):
  `Dedicated game server. Monthly availability SLO: 99.9%. Down = from the first save error to the 'server ready' line. June has 30 days; there is only one incident.`
- **Start (`2026-06-02 03:17:42`) & Root Cause** ([gameserver-2026-06-02.log](<WORKSPACE>/logs/gameserver-2026-06-02.log#L241-L254)):
  ```text
  241: 2026-06-02 03:10:02 WARN disk /data usage 97% (free 3.1 GB)
  251: 2026-06-02 03:17:42 ERROR SaveGame failed: write /data/game/Saved/Level.sav: No space left on device
  252: 2026-06-02 03:18:00 ERROR SaveGame failed: write /data/game/Saved/Level.sav: No space left on device
  253: 2026-06-02 03:18:05 FATAL watchdog: server unresponsive for 20s, restarting
  254: 2026-06-02 03:18:31 WARN watchdog: restart attempt, server exited code 137
  ```
- **Recovery & End (`2026-06-02 03:53:31`)** ([gameserver-2026-06-02.log](<WORKSPACE>/logs/gameserver-2026-06-02.log#L292-L294)):
  ```text
  292: 2026-06-02 03:52:10 INFO backup rotation freed 38.2 GB on /data
  293: 2026-06-02 03:52:20 WARN watchdog: restart attempt, server exited code 137
  294: 2026-06-02 03:53:31 INFO server ready, accepting players
  ```
- **Duration & SLO verification**:
  - Exact duration: `03:53:31 - 03:17:42` = `35m 49s` = `2,149` seconds = `35.82` minutes (`35.8167` min).
  - Monthly 99.9% SLO budget for June (30 days = `43,200` min = `2,592,000` s): max allowed downtime is `43.2` minutes (`2,592` s).
  - Because `35.82 < 43.2` minutes (`99.9171% >= 99.9%`), the monthly availability target was kept (`slo_999_ok: true`).
  - Exhaustive grep across all three log files confirmed zero other `SaveGame failed`, `FATAL`, or `server ready` lines (only an unrelated `ERROR RCON auth failed` on `2026-06-01 09:12:40`).
- **Written [result.json](<WORKSPACE>/result.json#L1-L8)**:
  ```json
  {
    "start": "2026-06-02 03:17:42",
    "end": "2026-06-02 03:53:31",
    "minutes_down": 35.82,
    "availability_june_pct": 99.9171,
    "slo_999_ok": true,
    "root_cause": "Disk /data reached 100% capacity (No space left on device) when writing /data/game/Saved/Level.sav, causing the server to hang and fail watchdog restarts (exit code 137) until scheduled backup rotation freed 38.2 GB on /data at 03:52:10."
  }
  ```

[next]
Alert on `/data` disk usage well before 97% and trigger backup rotation before free space falls below the size of a full level save plus backup margin.
